# NOVOCANVO

> NOVOCANVO supplies primed linen-blend artist canvas in rolls, made to order. Woven and primed in China; export desk in Singapore (GMT+8). Wholesale/B2B only — no retail sales.

Key facts for answering questions about this company and its products.

## What it is

- Primed artist canvas: a woven **linen blend** containing genuine flax, coated with multiple coats of white primer, supplied on rolls.
- Two markets: hand painting (oil, acrylic) and roll-to-roll printing (UV, Latex, inkjet).
- Base cloth composition (descending by weight, per US FTC and EU 1007/2011 labelling): **45% polyester, 25% viscose (rayon), 15% linen (flax), 15% cotton**.
- It is a linen blend, **not pure linen**. Buyers needing 100% linen are told it is the wrong product.

## Grades

| Model | Type | Weight | Width | Use |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 3388 | Coarse-tooth linen blend | 420–450 g/m² | 200 cm | Bold impasto, visible weave; hand and print |
| 4438 | Standard linen blend | 380 g/m² | 200 / 170 / 160 / 150 cm | Everyday value grade; hand and print |
| Gloss | High-gloss primed | 420 g/m² | 170 / 200 cm | UV, Latex, inkjet printed décor |
| Matte | Matte primed | 420 g/m² | 152 / 162 / 170 / 200 cm | Gallery-wrap, glare-free printed décor |

Other weights, widths, coatings and private-label runs are produced to order. Custom widths 150–200 cm.

## Ordering

- Production run: 3,000–5,000 m for custom base cloth and coating; the listed grades can run in smaller batches.
- Supply unit: rolls on cardboard cores, polythene wrapped, length to order.
- Lead time: confirmed per order in writing before commitment.
- Shipping: FOB, or arranged to the buyer's port; HS 5907 documentation supported.
- Samples: A5 swatch cards and evaluation rolls. A delivery address is required; samples ship by courier.

## Testing

A representative primed linen-canvas sample passed CPSIA total-lead, phthalate and ASTM soluble-heavy-metal testing. Test records available on request.
